identity.paletteIntent: Void black and bone, with red shoe red as the single accent, and each level adding its own era color: parchment, newsprint, mold green, phone violet, classified paper.
identity.typographyIntent: Type descends through time: blackletter for 1518, Playfair for 1944 newsprint, Special Elite for 1962, Inter for 2021, Space Mono for the open case.
identity.shapeLanguage: Concentric falling rings, playing card trap cards, a red shoe.
motionGrammar: accumulation in the crowd and the dish
identity.densityRhythm: Five levels, each with one interaction and one trap card, then four written answers.
identity.archivalBehavior: Public domain engravings by Hondius and Tenniel, Tenniel inverted to pale ink to match the Mind Games look with new figures. Real 1944 headlines. AP recording embedded.
identity.endingLanguage: Climb out with written answers and Turn In.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Red shoes given to dancers at the Saint Vitus shrine and Tenniel ink on black.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Paper plates with deep shadows; trap cards with offset red.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Ledger buttons, clue cards, newspaper dates, lab knobs, redaction bars.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Long dark gaps between levels to feel the fall.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Rings sink and dots spread; all motion stops under reduced motion.
